title: Victorian Library Portrait
prompt: A moody, period-inspired portrait of an original young woman standing in a softly blurred library filled with old leather-bound books and brass objects, cropped from mid-thigh up and framed vertically. Long, voluminous light auburn hair falls past her shoulders in soft, defined curls. She wears a fitted dark velvet jacket with a row of small buttons down the front and a high lace-trimmed collar fastened with an ornate brooch. A layered beaded bracelet sits on one wrist, and her arms are folded across her body. Her expression is serious and direct. Warm, soft lighting with gentle falloff into shadow, a muted palette of deep browns and burgundy, amber and gold from the wood and metalwork, and soft rose tones in her skin. Fine grain and slightly faded color give a vintage film look. Scholarly, dignified, and quietly intense, in the style of a historical fiction book cover or Victorian fashion editorial.
workingNotes:
- Suited to period drama posters or historical fiction covers.
- Can be shifted to a different era by changing the costume.
